title: Saturday assorted links
contentHtml:
1. Organizing Intelligence.

2. World Bank African urbanization report.  Building out African cities in a decent way could end up being the task of our coming era.

3. Summary of The Commanding Heights.

4. “Meanwhile in Armenia…”

5. “Female psychopathology has worsened despite increased resources and opportunities, suggesting it does not entirely reflect absolute deprivation, but rather, is a competitive adaptation activated by heightened social competition.”

6. One account of what is going on in Poland.  I am not endorsing that (or any other) interpretation, but if nothing else it shows you how interpretation of these events can make your head spin.  Grok has a simpler answer, again not endorsing.
